rules: recovered qosa-1.0.0 coded model; primary 3x9 plus one stock; physical branch/opening semantics provisional
policy: deterministic seed/turn/player hash selects a legal action index; validation-only, not a strategic arm
initialization: independent accepted first-round deals; 1-1 in stock triggers redeal and advance to next seed

scoreAdapter.eventOrder: ascending seat index (harness convention; not authenticated)

newFinding: Active PWA score events are sequential and manual. The first event that reaches 101 and leaves at most two survivors ends the match; later same-round seat events remain pending. The same deltas can explode different seats under different event orders.
scoringAssumption: Each seat receives its terminal hand pip sum; the empty finisher additionally receives finish-minus. This is an explicit research mapping assumption, not authenticated physical scoring.
limitations: Blocks are unscored because block winner/tie allocation is unresolved. The round stream uses independent accepted first-round deals, not actual match-start continuation. No strategy comparison, strategy promotion, or historical-baseline pooling.
nextAction: Matched three-order sensitivity audit over the same outcome stream, preserving block no-op and recording applied/pending events and exploded seat.
